title: Removing one unit deletes the entire cart line
description: When the same product has quantity two, clicking its Remove button deletes the whole line instead of removing one unit.

steps: Add Keyboard to the cart twice
report.expected: Keyboard should remain in the cart with quantity 1.
report.actual: The Keyboard line disappears and the cart becomes empty.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an initially empty cart.

steps: When the same product has quantity two, clicking its Remove button deletes the whole line instead of removing one unit.
